title: Onboard Calypso-Pro-13b v1.0: perf profiles, metadata, and automated changelog
author: Elena Park
description: Motivation: Add Calypso-Pro-13b v1.0 to the model registry with production-ready metadata, bench-marked performance profiles for common sequence lengths, and automated changelog/release note generation so that releases are documented consistently. This PR covers metadata ingestion, perf profile YAMLs, model tags, artifact pointers, and a small improvement to the changelog automation pipeline to include perf deltas and verified test results. Context: Calypso-Pro is a customer-requested 13B encoder-decoder variant optimized for long-context summarization workloads. We need a verified perf profile so serving runtime and pricing estimates are accurate. Scope: 1) Add model metadata: name, families, architecture, tokenizer spec, quantization recommendations, KVM notes, and known limitations. 2) Add perf profiles: latency and throughput matrices for seq_len=64/512/2048 on our standard GPU types (A100-80GB, H100-80GB, T4) and memory/kv-cache footprints. 3) Wire up changelog automation: when model metadata or perf profile files change, the changelog generator will create a release-note entry that includes perf summary and attaches the CI benchmark job link. 4) Tests and validation harness updates: add unit tests for metadata validation, integration test to run small perf sampling, and a smoke test in the eval-harness to confirm generation parity. Implementation notes: - metadata/calypso-pro-13b/v1.0/metadata.yaml added with required fields and schema v2 tags. - perf_profiles/calypso-pro-13b/v1.0/{a100.yaml,h100.yaml,t4.yaml} added; each profile includes sample throughput, median p95 latencies, and token-cost estimates. - scripts/changelog-generator: small enhancement to parse perf_profiles and include a "Performance" subsection in generated notes; feature guarded behind a flag CHG_AUTOMATE_PERF=true. - registry-metadata-validator: added new rules to validate tokenizer and kv-cache fields and a new unit test. - eval-harness: added a smoke bench using 4 small batches to validate perf numbers (CI-friendly sample). Release notes generation: changelog-generator now appends an entry to /changelogs/model-registry/ with templated fields: model name, version, summary, perf table, and test link. See README changelog section for example. Rollout and migration: model is staged under the "staging" visibility flag until a final review is complete; serving teams will be alerted via the registry webhook. If perf deltas exceed configured tolerances the automation will create a regression alert in Linear (ENG-4217). Testing performed: local benchmark runs on A100 and H100 pools, CI bench job triggered on PR which runs smoke perf and unit tests, manual verification of changelog output in a dev run. Checklist: - [x] Add metadata YAML - [x] Add perf profile YAMLs - [x] Update changelog-generator to include perf summaries - [x] Add unit/integration tests - [x] CI perf smoke job passing - [x] Review approvals from runtime and platform teams Rollback plan: revert the changelog-generator flag and remove staging visibility to prevent accidental publish; artifacts are immutable in the registry so a rollback is safe. Notes for reviewers: focus review on schema compliance (metadata.yaml), perf profile units and assumptions, and changelog template format. Related work: ENG-4217 (onboarding Calypso-Pro), PM-982 (pricing and catalog entry).

notes_on_automation: changelog-generator enhancement: when CHG_AUTOMATE_PERF=true the generator will ingest perf_profiles/*/summary.yaml to populate a Performance section. The generator will also compute relative delta vs latest published profile and, if delta > 10% for p95 latency or throughput, will add a regression flag to the Linear ticket referenced in linked_linear. This behavior is feature-flagged and covered by unit tests.
release_notes: Calypso-Pro-13b v1.0 added to model registry. Includes production metadata, A100/H100/T4 performance profiles (sampled), tokenizer and KV-cache guidance, and automated changelog entries with perf summaries. No breaking changes. Refer to changelogs/model-registry/2024-11-20-calypso-pro-13b-v1.0.md for full notes.
